title: 🆕 EB-05 'Heroines Edition Vol.2' is out — and it's reviving older cards
body: EB-05 Heroines Edition Vol.2 releases today (EN 30 Oct / JP 31 Oct). Beyond the new Nico Robin Leader and SP heroines, it's lifting demand — and prices — for older cards in other sets whose archetypes it makes playable again.

announcement.news: EB-05 'Heroines Edition Vol.2' launches 30 October (English) and 31 October (Japan) — ¥240 per pack in Japan, $4.99 per pack in English, 24 packs per box. It's the follow-up to the sold-out first Heroines set (EB-03), headlined by a Nico Robin Leader, SP versions of Nami and Robin, and several leader parallels.
announcement.analysis: The less obvious effect of a new set is that it reprices OLDER singles — by making dormant archetypes playable again. TCGplayer's late-October price trends tie several climbers directly to EB-05: new cards like Jewelry Bonney (EB05-001), Alvida (EB05-021) and Sugar (EB05-034) are reviving the Leaders and support pieces those decks already relied on. A separate catalyst, the 24 September Green Mihawk ban, is still pushing players toward Blue decks.
announcement.value: For players and collectors, the interesting part isn't just the new cards — it's which OLDER cards EB-05 makes relevant again. Per TCGplayer's price-trends (22 Sep–22 Oct window), notable climbers include Sugar (Royal Blood) parallel, Buggy (Emperors in the New World) parallel, Mr.3/Galdino (Premium Booster Vol.2), both Lucky.Roux printings, and Smoker (Royal Blood) parallel. If you already own these, they're gaining demand; if you're building those decks, EB-05 is what's enabling them.
announcement.deadline: EB-05 is out now (EN 30 Oct / JP 31 Oct). Related English 'Heroines Battle Vol.2' events run 6 Nov – 6 Dec.
announcement.risk: Launch-week prices are volatile — early premiums often compress as packs open and supply arrives. The moves cited are a specific late-October snapshot and some may have already retraced, and hype-driven reasons can reverse if the EB-05 cards underperform in play. Always check current prices before acting.

title: 🆕 OP-18 'The Dominance of God' — release dates confirmed (Nov 20 / 21)
body: Bandai set OP-18 'The Dominance of God' for 20 Nov (English) / 21 Nov (Japan) — $4.99 / ¥240 per pack, 127+1 card types. A Heroines Gift Collection (GC-2026) lands the same day.

announcement.news: Bandai has confirmed release dates for OP-18 'The Dominance of God' (Japanese: 神の支配) — 20 November 2026 (English) and 21 November 2026 (Japan), $4.99 per pack / ¥240, with 127+1 card types. Arriving the same day (20 Nov) is the Gift Collection -ONE PIECE Heroines- [GC-2026] ($44.99), which bundles 2 EB-05 packs, 70 sleeves and 10 new-art promo cards.
announcement.analysis: OP-18 is the next main booster set, and with dates now official (they weren't back in September), preorders should follow soon. There's no official card list yet — the card codes and 'leader reveals' circulating online aren't from a Bandai checklist, so treat them as rumour until confirmed.
announcement.value: For players, OP-18 is the next big set to plan decks around; for collectors, the Gift Collection (GC-2026) is the scarcer piece — it's allocation-limited (some stores report only a couple of displays each), so if you want it, watch for preorders early. As always, launch-day copies are usually the cheapest before the chase cards are known.
announcement.deadline: Release: 20 November (English) / 21 November (Japan). GC-2026 also 20 November. Preorders for allocated product often close before release — secure the Gift Collection early if you want it.
announcement.risk: No official card list yet, so contents and chase cards are unconfirmed (circulating codes are unofficial). Box pricing isn't official, and 'packs per display' figures come from single stores, not Bandai.

title: 🃏 New starter decks ST-37 (Alabasta) & ST-38 (Baroque Works) — out Dec 19
body: Bandai detailed two Japanese starter decks for 19 Dec 2026 (¥1,320 each): ST-37 'Desert Princess and the Pirates' (red/blue, Straw Hats + Vivi) and ST-38 'Baroque Works' (blue/black, Crocodile). Each has a 51-card deck, 10 DON!!, a bonus pack and a play sheet.

announcement.news: Bandai has revealed two new Japanese starter decks releasing 19 December 2026 at ¥1,320 each. ST-37 'Desert Princess and the Pirates' is a red/blue deck built around the Straw Hats and Alabasta (Vivi), while ST-38 'Baroque Works' is a blue/black deck led by Crocodile and the Baroque Works crew. Each set contains a 51-card constructed deck, 10 DON!! cards, a bonus pack and a play sheet.
announcement.analysis: Starter decks are the cheapest, most beginner-friendly way into the game, and splitting the desert (Alabasta) arc into two opposing decks — the Straw Hats/Vivi vs. Crocodile's Baroque Works — is a neat hook for new players and arc fans alike. Any reprinted staples inside can also ease prices on those singles.
announcement.value: For players, these are a low-cost way to grab a ready-to-play deck plus any reprinted staples cheaply; for collectors, the Alabasta (Vivi, Straw Hats) and Baroque Works (Crocodile) themes are the appeal. Early launch copies are usually the cheapest, before any chase cards drive demand.
announcement.deadline: Release: 19 December 2026. Preorder windows haven't been announced yet.
announcement.risk: Full card lists aren't out, so reprints and any chase cards are still unconfirmed. Starter decks are frequently reprinted, which tends to limit sealed-product upside.
